preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
The target score k is between 0 and 10^8 inclusive.
Input values n and k are integers.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (len(output_tokens) == n and all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in output_tokens) and len(set(output_tokens)) == n)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output n distinct integers between 1 and 10^9; otherwise output -1.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (sum(gcd(int(output_tokens[2*i]), int(output_tokens[2*i+1])) for i in range(n // 2)) == k)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the sum of GCDs of consecutive pairs (1st&2nd, 3rd&4th, etc.) equals k.

postconditions.expression: output == '-1' or (n % 2 == 1 and k == 0) or (n % 2 == 0 and k >= n // 2)
postconditions.description: A solution exists only if n is odd and k is 0, or n is even and k is at least n/2 (since minimum GCD is 1).
